newsitem.title: USA: San Antonio feeder cattle prices steady - USDA.
newsitem.headline: San Antonio feeder cattle prices steady - USDA.

text.p: Feeder steers and heifers were steady, compared to last week, USDA said.

Bulk of supply Medium and Large 1-2 300-600 lb feeder steers and heifers. Supply included around 12 percent slaughter cows and bulls; 30 percent feeder cattle over 600 lbs with balance mostly feeder cattle under 600 lbs.

Feeder Steers - Medium and Large 1 - 600-700 lbs 69.00-79.00, pkg 82.00; 700-800 lbs 67.00-72.00, pkg 75.25; 800-825 lbs 66.00-68.00. Medium and Large 1-2 - 600-1000 lbs 60.50-66.50. Large 2 - Holsteins - pkg 830 lbs 53.50.
Feeder Heifers - Medium and Large 1 - 600-700 lbs 66.00-72.50, pkg replacement quality 75.00; few 700-750 lbs 65.25-70.25. Medium and Large 1-2 - 500-700 lbs 60.00-66.00; 700- 900 lbs 56.25-63.00.
